lines: Roothe ho tum, tumko kaise manaaun, piya, bolo na, bolo na
couplets.en: You are upset with me, love, tell me how I can make it right.

lines: Khushboo ban ke aaun, saanson mein bas jaaun
couplets.en: Let me come like a fragrance and linger in your breath.

lines: Kaise tumko manaaun
couplets.en: How can I win you back?

lines: Roothe ho tum, tumko kaise manaaun, piya, bolo na, bolo na
couplets.en: You are upset with me, love, tell me how I can make it right.

lines: Tum bin, piya, jiya mora nahin laage
couplets.en: My heart finds no rest without you, love.

lines: Tadpe hai, tarse hai, saari raat jaage
couplets.en: It aches and longs and lies awake all night.

lines: Maanoge kaise, piya, yeh bata do
couplets.en: Tell me, love, what would bring you round?

lines: Jal jal ke mar jaaun, aise na saza do
couplets.en: Please spare me the slow burn of longing.

lines: Aansoo hain aankhon mein
couplets.en: Tears gather in my eyes.

lines: Halchal hai saanson mein
couplets.en: Even my breath is restless.

lines: Tum hi ko chaahoon main
couplets.en: You are the only one I long for.

lines: Roothe ho tum, tumko kaise manaaun, piya, bolo na, bolo na
couplets.en: You are upset with me, love, tell me how I can make it right.

lines: Dekho, piya, aise to na tadpaao
couplets.en: Please, love, do not make me ache like this.

lines: Jis dil mein rehte ho, usko na dukhaao
couplets.en: Be gentle with the heart you live in.

lines: Kya main karoon, piya, mujhe yeh bata do
couplets.en: Tell me what I can do, love.

lines: Tumko mere sar ki qasam, ab to muskura do
couplets.en: For my sake, let me see you smile.

lines: Warna main ro doongi
couplets.en: Or I shall start to cry.

lines: Phir na kabhi boloongi
couplets.en: Then I shall never speak again.

lines: Apni jaan de doongi
couplets.en: I would give my life.

lines: Roothe ho tum, tumko kaise manaaun, piya, bolo na, bolo na
couplets.en: You are upset with me, love, tell me how I can make it right.

lines: Khushboo ban ke aaun, saanson mein bas jaaun
couplets.en: Let me come like a fragrance and linger in your breath.

lines: Kaise tumko manaaun
couplets.en: How can I win you back?

lines: Tum jo kaho, tumko mar ke manaaun, piya, bolo na, bolo na
couplets.en: Say the word, love, and I would give my life to win you back.
